arguments.subject: Job Offer - Senior Project Manager - [Your Name]
arguments.body_markdown:
Dear Sarah,

Thank you very much for offering me the Senior Project Manager position. I truly appreciate the time and effort you and the team took to speak with me about the role and the company.

After much consideration, I have decided to decline the offer. While I was impressed by the team and the vision for the projects, I have chosen to pursue another opportunity that closely aligns with my current career path.

Thank you again for your time, consideration, and the opportunity. I wish you and the company all the best in finding the right person for the role, and I hope our paths cross in the future.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
